tagline.zh-CN: 纯本地运行的 App Store Connect 销售、首次下载与内购实时看板，密钥永不离机
tagline.en: 100% local-first App Store Connect sales, first-time downloads & IAP analytics dashboard

description.zh-CN: ASC Watcher 是专为 Apple 独立开发者与团队打造的本地优先 App Store Connect 销售与下载监控工具。通过官方 ES256 JWT 直连 Apple 接口，实时聚合每日与月度 TSV 报表，精准还原开发者净收益、首次下载量、内购与订阅明细、全球国家/地区分布以及多币种自动折算。无中转服务器、无第三方统计 SDK，您的 .p8 私钥与财务数据 100% 保存在手机本机，并支持手机系统桌面小组件实时速览。
description.en: ASC Watcher is a privacy-first, local-only App Store Connect sales and download analytics companion for indie developers and teams. Connecting directly to Apple's official API via on-device ES256 JWT signing, it aggregates daily and monthly TSV reports to track net developer proceeds, first-time downloads, in-app purchases, geographic breakdowns, and multi-currency conversions. With zero middleman servers and zero analytics SDKs, your .p8 private key and financial records never leave your device, complete with a live Home Screen Widget.

name.zh-CN: 本机 ES256 签名直连 Apple 官方接口
name.en: On-device ES256 JWT direct to Apple API

summary.zh-CN: 您的 Issuer ID、Key ID、Vendor Number 与 .p8 私钥仅保存在手机本地，App 在设备端实时生成 JWT 令牌直连 api.appstoreconnect.apple.com。
summary.en: Your Issuer ID, Key ID, Vendor Number, and .p8 private key never leave your phone. JWT tokens are signed locally to query api.appstoreconnect.apple.com directly.

detail.zh-CN: 市面上不少第三方统计工具要求把 App Store Connect 私钥上传到他们的云端服务器代拉报表，这意味着您的全盘财务数据与后台权限暴露在第三方手中。ASC Watcher 坚持零中转服务器架构，所有网络请求直接发往 Apple 官方接口。
detail.en: Many third-party analytics tools require uploading your App Store Connect private key to their cloud servers. ASC Watcher eliminates middleman risk: every request goes straight from your device to Apple.

name.zh-CN: 精准对齐 ASC 后台的首次下载与内购统计

summary.zh-CN: 严格按 Apple 官方 Product Type Identifier 区分首次下载（1/1F/1T/F1）与内购订阅（IA1/IA9/IAY），剔除自动更新（7/7F/7T）与重装干扰。
summary.en: Strictly separates first-time downloads (1/1F/1T/F1) from In-App Purchases & Subscriptions (IA1/IA9/IAY) while excluding auto-updates (7/7F/7T) and redownloads.

detail.zh-CN: 自动拉取历史月报（MONTHLY）与近期日报（DAILY）并智能去重拼接，同时通过 /v1/apps 补齐零销量新上架应用，并从 iTunes Lookup 自动匹配高清应用图标。
detail.en: Automatically merges historical monthly reports with recent daily reports without overlap, fetches all registered apps via /v1/apps, and resolves HD app icons.

name.zh-CN: 交互式柱状图与当日构成拆解
name.en: Interactive bar charts with daily breakdown

summary.zh-CN: 支持按日切换净收益、首次下载、内购笔数趋势图；手指点选任意一根柱子即可锁定并展开当日构成该总数的具体应用、内购商品或国家明细列表。
summary.en: Switch between net proceeds, first-time downloads, and IAP charts; tap any bar to lock it and inspect the exact apps, products, or countries that make up that day's total.

detail.zh-CN: 无论是全账号销售看板、趋势页还是单个 App 详情页，均支持点击卡片秒切走势指标，并可一键展开完整 90 天按日曲线与每日历史明细。
detail.en: Across the main Sales dashboard, Trends tab, and individual App Detail pages, tap metric cards to switch charts and expand full 90-day daily histories.

name.zh-CN: 多币种自动折算与前二原始币种透视
name.en: Multi-currency auto conversion & top-2 original currencies

summary.zh-CN: 支持 USD、CNY、EUR、GBP、JPY、HKD、TWD、AUD、CAD 九大主流货币一键切换，同时在括号内保留价值最高的前 2 个原始结算币种（如 $6.79 + ₹575.55）。
summary.en: Switch seamlessly between 9 display currencies (USD, CNY, EUR, GBP, JPY, HKD, TWD, AUD, CAD) while viewing the top 2 original settlement currencies side by side.

detail.zh-CN: 严格过滤免费下载行的空币种干扰，只对真实产生开发者净收益（Developer Proceeds != 0）的交易按原始结算币种聚合，既看清折算总额，又不错过各区真实入账。
detail.en: Free download rows never pollute currency buckets—only rows with non-zero Developer Proceeds are aggregated into original settlement currencies.

name.zh-CN: 手机系统桌面小组件（Home Screen Widget）

summary.zh-CN: 支持将 4×2 销售与下载看板添加到手机主屏幕，无需打开 App 即可随时扫一眼开发者净收益、昨日首次下载、累计首次下载与支付笔数。
summary.en: Pin a 4×2 dashboard widget to your phone's home screen to check net developer proceeds, yesterday's downloads, total first-time downloads, and paid transactions at a glance.

detail.zh-CN: 完美适配浅色与深色模式，提供应用内实景预览与一键固定到桌面功能，每次下拉刷新报表即自动同步桌面小组件。
detail.en: Adapts to Light and Dark themes with an in-app live preview and one-tap home screen pinning.

q.zh-CN: ASC Watcher 会把我的 .p8 私钥或销售数据上传到你们的服务器吗？
q.en: Does ASC Watcher upload my .p8 private key or sales data to your servers?

a.zh-CN: 绝对不会。ASC Watcher 没有账号系统，也没有任何自建后端服务器。您输入的 Issuer ID、Key ID、Vendor Number 与 .p8 私钥仅保存在您的手机本地存储中，所有 JWT 签名均在设备本地完成后直接请求 Apple 官方接口（api.appstoreconnect.apple.com）。
a.en: Never. ASC Watcher has no user accounts and no backend servers of its own. Your Issuer ID, Key ID, Vendor Number, and .p8 private key are stored strictly on your device, and ES256 JWT tokens are signed locally to communicate directly with Apple (api.appstoreconnect.apple.com).

q.zh-CN: 为什么没有配置 API 密钥也能看到数据？
q.en: Why can I see data before configuring an API key?

a.zh-CN: 首次打开且未配置凭据时，应用默认提供内置的「演示模式（Demo Mode）」示例数据，方便您直观体验全部图表交互、币种切换与多维拆解。您随时可以在「更多 → API 凭据配置」中填入真实密钥切换为实时数据。
a.en: When launched without credentials, ASC Watcher provides a built-in Demo Mode with realistic sample data so you can explore every chart, currency switch, and breakdown immediately. Configure your real key anytime under More → Credentials Setup.

q.zh-CN: 应该给 API Key 分配什么权限角色？
q.en: What role should I assign to my App Store Connect API Key?

a.zh-CN: 建议在 App Store Connect「用户和访问 → 集成 → App Store Connect API」中创建一个仅勾选「财务（Finance）」或「销售和趋势（Sales and Reports）」只读权限的密钥，既能完整拉取报表，又遵循最小权限安全原则。
a.en: We recommend creating a key under App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations with read-only 'Sales and Reports' or 'Finance' access, following the principle of least privilege.

q.zh-CN: 如何添加手机桌面小组件？
q.en: How do I add the Home Screen Widget?

a.zh-CN: 进入「更多 → 手机桌面小组件」，可先预览深色/浅色实景效果并点击「一键添加到手机桌面」；也可以长按手机主屏幕空白处，在系统「小组件 / 窗口小工具」列表中找到 ASC Watcher 并拖入桌面。
a.en: Go to More → Home Screen Widget to preview the widget and tap 'Pin Widget to Home Screen', or long-press an empty area on your phone's home screen and select ASC Watcher from the system widget gallery.
